exercise.title: West Filtration Pump Response (fictional Phase 1 case)
exercise.scenario: A wholly fictional water utility exercise reviews an intake pressure alarm, pump response timing, an ambiguous flow report, and an unverified causal guess.

objectives.text: Restore stable west filtration header flow within five minutes of the intake pressure alarm.

start_terms: intake pressure alarm sounded at the west filtration header
completion_terms: backup intake pump reached stable flow at the west filtration header
evaluation_rule.finding_title: West header flow restored within the target

objectives.text: Verify stable flow at the east intake.

terms: east intake flow was verified stable

objectives.text: Determine the cause of the south pump room transfer delay from confirmed evidence.

observations.wording: Intake pressure alarm sounded at the west filtration header.
Backup intake pump reached stable flow at the west filtration header.
Generator load transfer was requested for the south pump room.
Generator transfer to the south pump room completed.
Shift supervisor independently reports: the intake pressure alarm sounded at the west filtration header at 08:00.
The south transfer may have been delayed by a sticking float sensor; no inspection confirmed a cause.
At the east intake, crew members thought flow had stabilized before lunch, but no one verified it.

unknowns.expected: Speculative sensor cause has no event timestamp or confirming inspection.
Approximate 'before lunch' narrative is untimed and explicitly unverified.
